title: Defying Destiny
next_chapter_hook: The gaze of the Heavenly Eye completely shifted, and the location of the complete Tianji Record appeared for the first time—it is in the depths of the Heavenly Eye's core, and Chen Ji's father, Chen Tianming, might still be alive.

text.content: Just as the boundary between the third and fourth pages of the Tianji Record began to blur, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented force breaking free from its shackles—and he had to make a choice in that instant, enduring fate's ultimate backlash. The force was like ten thousand blades slicing simultaneously into his meridians, every inch of flesh screaming in agony. The backlash from the shackles came so violently it seemed intent on tearing his soul apart. But he was prepared—his left hand slammed onto his crown, flooding all his Heavenly Fate Value into his bloodline, letting the backlash surge through his limbs like a tide.

dialogue.content: "You're mad!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently. "Flooding all your Heavenly Fate Value into your bloodline? This is no different from seeking death!"

text.content: A cold smile actually curved Chen Ji's lips. In this extreme pain, he反而 felt an unprecedented clarity—the scenes from Chapter 700's death prophecy unfolded like a shattered scroll before his eyes. The threads of fate wound around his neck; one careless move and they would tighten. And now, he intended to personally sever one of them.

choice.prompt: The shackles' backlash surged like a tide, the crucial moment of bloodline awakening—how would Chen Ji endure this heart-wrenching agony?

choices.text: Using pain to counter pain, forcibly suppressing it
choices.description: Transform pain into a catalyst for power, using willpower to forcibly suppress the backlash, accelerating the completion of bloodline awakening
choices.risk_hint: If it fails, he will die directly

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth until they shattered, blood flowing down his lips. He didn't scream; instead, he let out a low growl—compressing the pain like wringing out a cloth, squeezing it into power, and reverse-flooding it into his bloodline.

choices.text: Guide the backlash, find another way
choices.description: Not hard resistance against the backlash force, but guiding it toward the Tianji Record, using it as a medium to transform this destructive power
choices.visible_cost: May damage the Tianji Record Fragment
choices.visible_reward: Tianji Record fourth layer unlock progress improved
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record may be damaged as a result

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, guiding that destructive force toward the Tianji Record. Every previous guidance had pained him, but this time was different—he was gambling big.

The moment Chen Ji transformed pain into power, something in the depths of his bloodline seemed to awaken. A brilliant golden light bloomed from his chest, like a giant beast sleeping for millennia opening its eyes. Bloodline awakening—eighty percent! His meridians widened tenfold in an instant, and his true essence surged out like a breached dam.

At the same time, the boundary between the third and fourth pages of the Tianji Record completely vanished. The originally incomplete pages began self-repairing, densely packed runes wriggling and arranging like living things. An ancient and majestic voice rang in his mind: "Fourth layer of the Tianji Record, unlocked." At this moment, Chen Ji felt fate's pulse—he could touch it now.

dialogue.content: "This is... Defying Destiny!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out an exclamation. "What the fourth layer of the Tianji Record grants you is the power to rewrite fate! Within a short time, you can ignore the laws of heaven and directly篡改 established fate trajectories!"

text.content: Chen Ji felt this brand new power. This wasn't about foresight of the future, but directly rewriting the future! As long as he paid the sufficient price, he could turn the impossible into the possible. Chapter 700's death prophecy flickered before his eyes—that destined ending had developed its first crack.

choice.prompt: The fourth layer of the Tianji Record is unlocked, the power to defy destiny at his fingertips—how will Chen Ji use this power to rewrite fate?

choices.description: Immediately use the new ability to modify one small detail of Chapter 700's death ending, buying himself a sliver of hope
choices.visible_reward: First flaw appears in the death prophecy
choices.risk_hint: The commotion might alert higher beings

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate, his hands forming seals, a golden rune shooting from his fingertips, directly cutting into Chapter 700's death prophecy. That originally unbreakable thread of fate, he actually managed to shake it slightly!

choices.text: First stabilize the foundation, set up secretly
choices.description: Not rush for success, first fully digest the new ability, use foresight to find the best timing before acting

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the impulse in his heart. At this critical juncture, rash action would only expose his trump cards. He sat cross-legged, beginning to digest this brand new power, while using the Tianji Record to deduce the next move.

The instant Chen Ji rewrote the death prophecy, his perception suddenly expanded to a new dimension. He felt a gaze from the nine heavens— it was the Heavenly Eye! Its gaze had pressed down on him like a mountain, and now that pressure was shifting. As if something more important had appeared.

dialogue.content: A cold voice drifted from the depths of the void: "Interesting... an ant actually learned to bite the heavens." That voice held no anger, but a hint of playfulness. "But do you think that's enough?"

text.content: The moment the Heavenly Eye's gaze shifted, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented lightness. But immediately after, a deeper chill crept into his heart—he realized something. The location of the complete Tianji Record appeared clearly in his mind at this moment. It wasn't in any secret realm, but within the Heavenly Eye's core! That place is where all heavenly secrets converge.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently: "Your father... Chen Tianming! He didn't truly die back then, but was trapped in the Heavenly Eye's deepest depths! If you could enter there..."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart clenched sharply. Father... still alive? That man who vanished protecting the Tianji Record had actually been waiting there for his son to save him? Chen Ji's eyes slightly reddened, but quickly returned to calm. No matter what, he had to become stronger.

choice.prompt: The news that his father might still be alive struck like thunder—how will Chen Ji face this information that changes everything?

choices.text: Immediately ask Mo Xiansheng for details
choices.description: Press Mo Xiansheng for the truth about his father's imprisonment, and how to enter the Heavenly Eye's core
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng might be hiding something

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his voice calm yet with a tremor: "Mo Xiansheng, my father... what exactly happened?" This was the first time he showed such obvious emotional fluctuation before Mo Xiansheng.

choices.description: Bury this news deep in his heart, analyze the situation with cold calculation, cannot let emotions affect judgment
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity for honesty with Mo Xiansheng

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the surging emotions. He was very clear— at this critical juncture, any emotional fluctuation could become a fatal weakness. His father's matter could only be placed at the chess game's end.

Chen Ji slowly stood up, feeling the brand new power within his body. The fourth layer of the Tianji Record was unlocked, the power to defy destiny under his complete control. Chapter 700's death prophecy had been pried open by him; although it was still far from complete rewriting, this already proved one thing—fate is not unchangeable.

And in the nine heavens, the Heavenly Eye's gaze had completely shifted. That gaze originally locked on Chen Ji was now directed toward a farther place—where, it seemed, larger variables were brewing. A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips: It thought shifting attention would make him be ignored? How可笑. From this moment on, he was no longer a chess piece to be manipulated.

dialogue.content: "Father... wait for me." Chen Ji said softly, his voice calm yet resolute. "And you, Heavenly Eye—do you think I'm a chess piece? One day, I will let this world see what it means to have flawless strategy."

text.content: The Tianji Record glowed faintly in his hands, the runes on the fourth page fully revealed. And in that page's deepest depths, a line of faint text was visible—that was the guide to the complete Tianji Record's location. Chen Ji fixed his gaze on the nine heavens, a flash of determination in his eyes. Defying destiny—he had taken the first step. And next, it was time to truly enter the hall.

Just then, Chen Ji sensed a familiar aura approaching— it was Su Qingyao. She seemed to have detected the anomaly here, rushing toward this location at full speed. Chen Ji slightly furrowed his brow, suppressing the Tianji Record's aura to its absolute limit. He still needed time to digest all this. Before Su Qingyao arrived, he had to cover all vulnerabilities clean. After all, he still had to continue playing the role of that废物 servant disciple until the final moment.

However, just as Chen Ji was about to suppress his aura, the text at the Tianji Record fourth page's deepest point suddenly glowed. A coordinate, an image, simultaneously flooded his mind— within the Heavenly Eye's deepest depths, within endless chaos, a man's silhouette flickered in and out of visibility. That silhouette bore seven-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji, gazing toward this direction with complex eyes. Chen Tianming... he truly was alive. And now, his son finally had the possibility to contact him.

Chen Ji's fists slowly clenched tight. He had done it—the first step of defying destiny, he had taken. And the chess game ahead would be more dangerous than any before. Although the Heavenly Eye's gaze had shifted, those eyes could return at any moment. Before that, he had to set up a board deep enough to capture all enemies in one net.

In the distance, Su Qingyao's silhouette had already appeared at the horizon's end. Chen Ji took a deep breath, concealing all emotions, putting on that weak, peaceful mask again. But deep within his eyes, a flame was burning. Father... wait for me. No matter what price, he would rescue that man from the Heavenly Eye's core. This was his second step in defying destiny, and the most important one. The chessboard of fate had unfolded, and the one holding the pieces— it would ultimately be him, Chen Ji.
